test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Launched in March 2023, the VAIBHAV fellowship for Indian diaspora that aims at improving the research ecosystem of India’s Higher Educational and Scientific Institutions is for a researcher engaged in an overseas academic/research/industrial organisation working in the top _________ QS World University Ranking.
solution:
The correct answer is __**500**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The VAIBHAV fellowship launched in March 2023 aims to improve the research ecosystem of India's Higher Educational and Scientific Institutions.
 
• The fellowship is targeted at researchers engaged in overseas academic, research, or industrial organizations.
 
• Eligible researchers must be working in institutions that are ranked in the top **500** of the QS World University Rankings.
 
• This initiative is part of India's efforts to leverage the expertise of its diaspora to enhance the country's research capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The QS World University Rankings are annual university rankings published by Quacquarelli Symonds (QS).
 
• The rankings provide a comprehensive overview of the world's top universities based on various performance indicators.
 
• The VAIBHAV fellowship is one among several initiatives aimed at fostering international collaboration and bringing global expertise to India.
 
• Such initiatives are crucial for enhancing the quality of education and research in Indian institutions and for keeping pace with global advancements.
